title: Recovering from Burnout
paragraphs: Setelah berbulan-bulan bekerja enam puluh jam seminggu tanpa istirahat yang layak, Zaid akhirnya kolaps karena kelelahan pada suatu Minggu pagi, tidak bisa bangun dari tempat tidur meski merasa sudah cukup tidur.
Dokternya mendiagnosis burnout dan menyarankan istirahat penuh dua minggu dari pekerjaan, saran yang awalnya ditolak Zaid, khawatir bagaimana timnya akan mengelola beban kerja tanpa dirinya.

Selama istirahat paksa itu, ia perlahan menyadari bahwa ketersediaannya yang konstan sebenarnya membuat timnya kurang mampu menyelesaikan masalah secara mandiri, karena mereka selalu menunggu masukannya terlebih dahulu.

Ketika ia kembali, Zaid menetapkan batasan yang lebih jelas seputar jam kerjanya, dan mengejutkannya, timnya tetap berkinerja baik, mengajarinya bahwa kesehatannya sama pentingnya dengan hasil kerjanya.
answerKey: After months of working sixty-hour weeks without a proper break, Zaid finally collapsed from exhaustion on a Sunday morning, unable to get out of bed despite feeling like he had slept enough. His doctor diagnosed burnout and recommended a full two weeks away from work, advice that Zaid initially resisted, worried about how his team would manage the workload without him present. During his forced break, he gradually realized that his constant availability had actually made his team less capable of solving problems independently, since they always waited for his input first. When he returned, Zaid set clearer boundaries around his working hours, and surprisingly, his team performed just as well, teaching him that his health mattered as much as his output.
